```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin Sign-In Handler
 *
 * Validates credentials against the administrator table.
 * Contains no SQL — all data access goes through admin-queries.php.
 *
 * DEVELOPMENT-ONLY BYPASS: seed data stores plaintext passwords.
 * Remove before any non-local deployment.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 1.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../shared/backend/database/database-connect.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../database/admin-queries.php';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'Invalid request method.';
    header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token'], $_SESSION['csrf_token'])
    || !hash_equals((string)$_SESSION['csrf_token'], (string)$_POST['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'Security validation failed. Please try again.';
    header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

$identifier = trim((string)($_POST['identifier'] ?? ''));
$password   = (string)($_POST['password'] ?? '');

if ($identifier === '' || $password === '') {
    $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'Please enter your email/username and password.';
    header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

try {
    $admin = findAdminByIdentifier($database_connection, $identifier);

    if (!$admin) {
        $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'Invalid email/username or password.';
        header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
        exit;
    }

    if ((int)$admin['is_active'] !== 1) {
        $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'Your account has been deactivated. Please contact support.';
        header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
        exit;
    }

    $passwordValid = password_verify($password, (string)$admin['password']);

    // ---- DEVELOPMENT-ONLY BYPASS ----
    if (!$passwordValid && hash_equals((string)$admin['password'], $password)) {
        $passwordValid = true;
    }
    // ---- END BYPASS ----

    if (!$passwordValid) {
        $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'Invalid email/username or password.';
        header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
        exit;
    }

    session_regenerate_id(true);

    $_SESSION['administrator_id'] = (int)$admin['administrator_id'];
    $_SESSION['user_role']        = 'admin';
    $_SESSION['user_name']        = trim(($admin['first_name'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($admin['last_name'] ?? ''));
    $_SESSION['user_email']       = (string)($admin['email'] ?? '');
    $_SESSION['admin_role']       = (string)($admin['role'] ?? 'support');
    $_SESSION['created']          = time();

    recordAdminLogin($database_connection, (int)$admin['administrator_id']);

    unset($_SESSION['csrf_token']);

    header('Location: ../../pages/dashboard.php');
    exit;

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('Admin sign-in DB error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    $_SESSION['login_error'] = 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.';
    header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
    exit;
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin Sign-Out Handler
 *
 * Clears only admin-specific session data. Other role sessions
 * (customer, rider, restaurant) remain intact.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 1.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

unset(
    $_SESSION['administrator_id'],
    $_SESSION['user_role'],
    $_SESSION['user_name'],
    $_SESSION['user_email'],
    $_SESSION['admin_role']
);

session_regenerate_id(true);

header('Location: ../../pages/sign-in.php');
exit;
```

```php
 * Admin-specific header with conditional navigation based on login
 * status. Mirrors customer/includes/header.php and
 * rider/includes/header.php so all three roles stay consistent in
 * behavior, asset resolution, and CSS load order.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 2.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

// ===== SESSION =====
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

if (!isset($_SESSION['created'])) {
    $_SESSION['created'] = time();
} elseif (time() - $_SESSION['created'] > 1800) {
    session_regenerate_id(true);
    $_SESSION['created'] = time();
}

// ===== DATABASE =====
require_once __DIR__ . '/../backend/database/admin-connect.php';

// ===== PATH DETECTION =====
function getAdminAssetBase(): string
{
    $scriptPath = $_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'];
    $dirPath    = dirname($scriptPath);
    $segments   = array_filter(explode('/', $dirPath));
    $depth      = count($segments);
    return $depth <= 0 ? './shared/' : str_repeat('../', $depth) . 'shared/';
}

$assetBase = getAdminAssetBase();

// ===== FETCH ADMIN DATA (if logged in) =====
$isLoggedIn   = false;
$adminName    = '';
$adminInitial = '';
$adminRole    = '';

if (!empty($_SESSION['administrator_id'])) {
    $isLoggedIn = true;
    try {
        $stmt = $database_connection->prepare(
            "SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, ap.role
             FROM administrator a
             LEFT JOIN administrator_profile ap ON a.administrator_id = ap.administrator_id
             WHERE a.administrator_id = :id
             LIMIT 1"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':id' => (int)$_SESSION['administrator_id']]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row) {
            $adminName    = trim(($row['first_name'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($row['last_name'] ?? ''));
            $adminInitial = strtoupper(substr((string)($row['first_name'] ?? 'A'), 0, 1));
            $adminRole    = (string)($row['role'] ?? '');
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        // Silently fail — login state still valid
    }
}

// ===== CURRENT PAGE =====
$currentPage = basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);

// ===== PAGE-SPECIFIC CSS =====
$pageCssMap = [
    'sign-in.php'      => 'sign-in.css',
    'dashboard.php'    => 'dashboard.css',
    'customers.php'    => 'admin-tables.css',
    'riders.php'       => 'admin-tables.css',
    'restaurants.php'  => 'admin-tables.css',
    'profile.php'      => 'profile.css',
];

$pageCssFile = $pageCssMap[$currentPage] ?? '';
$pageCssPath = '';
if ($pageCssFile !== '' && file_exists(__DIR__ . '/../assets/css/' . $pageCssFile)) {
    $pageCssPath = '../assets/css/' . $pageCssFile;
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin — Customers List
 *
 * Paginated list of customer accounts with search, status tabs, and
 * a per-customer detail modal. All mutations go through
 * admin-handler.php via normal form POSTs. No window.confirm().
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 2.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

if (empty($_SESSION['administrator_id'])) {
    header('Location: sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/header.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../backend/database/admin-queries.php';

$adminId = (int)$_SESSION['administrator_id'];

$page     = isset($_GET['page']) ? max(1, (int)$_GET['page']) : 1;
$search   = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim((string)$_GET['search']) : '';
$status   = isset($_GET['status']) ? (string)$_GET['status'] : 'all';
$openId   = isset($_GET['open']) ? (int)$_GET['open'] : 0;
$perPage  = 5;

$allowedStatuses = ['all', 'active', 'inactive'];
if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
    $status = 'all';
}

$counts = getCustomerCountsByStatus($database_connection);
$data   = getCustomersPaginated($database_connection, $page, $perPage, $search, $status);
$rows   = $data['rows'];
$pagination = $data;

// If the URL asked us to open a specific customer, load it.
$openCustomer = null;
$openAddresses = [];
$openOrders = [];
if ($openId > 0) {
    $openCustomer = getCustomerDetails($database_connection, $openId);
    if ($openCustomer) {
        $openAddresses = getCustomerAddresses($database_connection, $openId);
        $openOrders    = getCustomerRecentOrders($database_connection, $openId, 5);
    }
}

if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}
$csrfToken = $_SESSION['csrf_token'];

/**
 * Build a query string preserving current filters.
 */
function buildCustomerUrl(array $overrides = []): string
{
    $params = [
        'page'   => $_GET['page']   ?? 1,
        'search' => $_GET['search'] ?? '',
        'status' => $_GET['status'] ?? 'all',
    ];
    foreach ($overrides as $k => $v) {
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            unset($params[$k]);
        } else {
            $params[$k] = $v;
        }
    }
    return '?' . http_build_query($params);
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin Dashboard
 *
 * Overview of platform health and the moderation queue.
 *
 * Three concerns, in priority order:
 *   1. Platform counts (customers, restaurants, riders, revenue)
 *   2. Revenue trend (7-day chart)
 *   3. Moderation queue (pending riders + recently verified)
 *
 * There is deliberately NO "recent orders" panel here. Order-level
 * operations belong to the restaurant and rider dashboards. Admin
 * cares about who is on the platform and who just got approved.
 *
 * All SQL lives in admin-queries.php.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 3.0 — Removed recent-orders panel. Added recently-verified
 *                activity feed.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

if (empty($_SESSION['administrator_id'])) {
    header('Location: sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/header.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../backend/database/admin-queries.php';

$adminId = (int)$_SESSION['administrator_id'];
$adminProfile = getAdminProfile($database_connection, $adminId) ?: [];
$firstName = (string)($adminProfile['first_name'] ?? 'Admin');

$stats = getAdminDashboardStats($database_connection);

// ----- Weekly revenue chart -----
$weeklyRevenue = getAdminWeeklyRevenue($database_connection, 7);

$weeklyMax = 0.0;
foreach ($weeklyRevenue as $d) {
    if ($d['amount'] > $weeklyMax) $weeklyMax = $d['amount'];
}
$chartScale   = getAdminChartScale($weeklyMax);
$chartCeiling = $chartScale['ceiling'];
$today        = date('Y-m-d');

$barHeights = [];
foreach ($weeklyRevenue as $d) {
    $pct = $chartCeiling > 0 ? ($d['amount'] / $chartCeiling) * 100 : 0;
    $barHeights[$d['date']] = $d['amount'] > 0 ? max(4, min(100, $pct)) : 0;
}

// ----- Pending riders (top 5) -----
$pendingRidersData = getRidersPaginated($database_connection, 1, 5, '', 'pending');
$pendingRiders = $pendingRidersData['rows'];

// ----- Recently verified / denied (activity feed) -----
$recentActivity = getRecentVerificationActivity($database_connection, 6);

if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}
$csrfToken = $_SESSION['csrf_token'];
?>
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin — Restaurants List
 *
 * Paginated restaurant list with verification tabs, search, and a
 * detail modal that shows branches and account holders.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 2.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

if (empty($_SESSION['administrator_id'])) {
    header('Location: sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/header.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../backend/database/admin-queries.php';

$adminId = (int)$_SESSION['administrator_id'];

$page   = isset($_GET['page']) ? max(1, (int)$_GET['page']) : 1;
$search = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim((string)$_GET['search']) : '';
$status = isset($_GET['status']) ? (string)$_GET['status'] : 'all';
$openId = isset($_GET['open']) ? (int)$_GET['open'] : 0;
$perPage = 5;

$allowedStatuses = ['all', 'pending', 'verified', 'denied', 'suspended'];
if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
    $status = 'all';
}

$counts = getRestaurantCountsByStatus($database_connection);
$data   = getRestaurantsPaginated($database_connection, $page, $perPage, $search, $status);
$rows   = $data['rows'];
$pagination = $data;

$openRestaurant = null;
$openBranches = [];
$openAccounts = [];

if ($openId > 0) {
    $openRestaurant = getRestaurantDetails($database_connection, $openId);
    if ($openRestaurant) {
        $openBranches = getRestaurantBranches($database_connection, $openId);
        $openAccounts = getRestaurantAccounts($database_connection, $openId);
    }
}

if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}
$csrfToken = $_SESSION['csrf_token'];

function buildRestaurantUrl(array $overrides = []): string
{
    $params = [
        'page'   => $_GET['page']   ?? 1,
        'search' => $_GET['search'] ?? '',
        'status' => $_GET['status'] ?? 'all',
    ];
    foreach ($overrides as $k => $v) {
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            unset($params[$k]);
        } else {
            $params[$k] = $v;
        }
    }
    return '?' . http_build_query($params);
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin — Riders List
 *
 * Paginated rider list with verification tabs. Row actions trigger
 * the confirm modal, not window.confirm(). The detail modal has two
 * tabs: Information and Documents. Documents uses its own 5-per-page
 * pagination so profile picture and license photos are readable.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 2.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

if (empty($_SESSION['administrator_id'])) {
    header('Location: sign-in.php');
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/header.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../backend/database/admin-queries.php';

$adminId = (int)$_SESSION['administrator_id'];

$page    = isset($_GET['page']) ? max(1, (int)$_GET['page']) : 1;
$search  = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim((string)$_GET['search']) : '';
$status  = isset($_GET['status']) ? (string)$_GET['status'] : 'all';
$openId  = isset($_GET['open']) ? (int)$_GET['open'] : 0;
$docPage = isset($_GET['doc_page']) ? max(1, (int)$_GET['doc_page']) : 1;
$perPage = 5;

$allowedStatuses = ['all', 'pending', 'verified', 'denied', 'suspended'];
if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
    $status = 'all';
}

$counts = getRiderCountsByStatus($database_connection);
$data   = getRidersPaginated($database_connection, $page, $perPage, $search, $status);
$rows   = $data['rows'];
$pagination = $data;

// Detail modal loads
$openRider = null;
$openAddress = null;
$openContacts = [];
$openDocuments = [];
$openDeliveries = [];

if ($openId > 0) {
    $openRider = getRiderDetails($database_connection, $openId);
    if ($openRider) {
        $openAddress    = getRiderAddress($database_connection, $openId);
        $openContacts   = getRiderEmergencyContacts($database_connection, $openId);
        $openDocuments  = getRiderDocuments($database_connection, $openId);
        $openDeliveries = getRiderRecentDeliveries($database_connection, $openId, 5);
    }
}

if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}
$csrfToken = $_SESSION['csrf_token'];

/**
 * Build a query string preserving filters.
 */
function buildRiderUrl(array $overrides = []): string
{
    $params = [
        'page'     => $_GET['page']     ?? 1,
        'search'   => $_GET['search']   ?? '',
        'status'   => $_GET['status']   ?? 'all',
        'doc_page' => $_GET['doc_page'] ?? 1,
    ];
    foreach ($overrides as $k => $v) {
        if ($v === null || $v === '') {
            unset($params[$k]);
        } else {
            $params[$k] = $v;
        }
    }
    return '?' . http_build_query($params);
}

/**
 * A rider's media URL: strip the trailing 'shared/' from $assetBase
 * to get the project root, then append the DB-relative path.
 */
function riderMediaUrl(string $assetBase, string $relPath): string
{
    if ($relPath === '') return '';
    $projectRoot = preg_replace('#shared/$#', '', $assetBase);
    return (is_string($projectRoot) ? $projectRoot : '') . $relPath;
}

                <span class="admin-pagination-info">
                    Showing page <?php echo $pagination['page']; ?> of <?php echo $pagination['totalPages']; ?>
                    (<?php echo number_format($pagination['total']); ?> total)
                </span>
                <ul class="admin-pagination-list">
                    <?php if ($pagination['page'] > 1): ?>
                    <li>
                        <a href="<?php echo htmlspecialchars(buildRiderUrl(['page' => $pagination['page'] - 1, 'open' => null]), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>"
                            class="admin-pagination-link">Previous</a>
                    </li>
                    <?php else: ?>
                    <li><span class="admin-pagination-link disabled">Previous</span></li>
                    <?php endif; ?>

                    <?php
                    $maxVisible = 5;
                    $start = max(1, $pagination['page'] - (int)floor($maxVisible / 2));
                    $end   = min($pagination['totalPages'], $start + $maxVisible - 1);
                    if ($end - $start + 1 < $maxVisible) {
                        $start = max(1, $end - $maxVisible + 1);
                    }
                    if ($start > 1): ?>
                    <li>
                        <a href="<?php echo htmlspecialchars(buildRiderUrl(['page' => 1, 'open' => null]), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>"
                            class="admin-pagination-link">1</a>
                    </li>
                    <?php if ($start > 2): ?>
                    <li><span class="admin-pagination-ellipsis">…</span></li>
                    <?php endif; endif; ?>

                    <?php for ($i = $start; $i <= $end; $i++): ?>
                    <li>
                        <?php if ($i === $pagination['page']): ?>
                        <span class="admin-pagination-link active"><?php echo $i; ?></span>
                        <?php else: ?>
                        <a href="<?php echo htmlspecialchars(buildRiderUrl(['page' => $i, 'open' => null]), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>"
                            class="admin-pagination-link"><?php echo $i; ?></a>
                        <?php endif; ?>
                    </li>
                    <?php endfor; ?>

                    <?php if ($end < $pagination['totalPages']): ?>
                    <?php if ($end < $pagination['totalPages'] - 1): ?>
                    <li><span class="admin-pagination-ellipsis">…</span></li>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                    <li>
                        <a href="<?php echo htmlspecialchars(buildRiderUrl(['page' => $pagination['totalPages'], 'open' => null]), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>"
                            class="admin-pagination-link"><?php echo $pagination['totalPages']; ?></a>
                    </li>
                    <?php endif; ?>

                    <?php if ($pagination['page'] < $pagination['totalPages']): ?>
                    <li>
                        <a href="<?php echo htmlspecialchars(buildRiderUrl(['page' => $pagination['page'] + 1, 'open' => null]), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>"
                            class="admin-pagination-link">Next</a>
                    </li>
                    <?php else: ?>
                    <li><span class="admin-pagination-link disabled">Next</span></li>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                </ul>
            </nav>
            <?php endif; ?>
            <?php endif; ?>
        </div>
    </div>
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * FitPal Admin Sign-In Page
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 2.0
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

if (!empty($_SESSION['administrator_id'])) {
    header('Location: dashboard.php');
    exit;
}

if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/header.php';

$errorMessage = $_SESSION['login_error'] ?? '';
unset($_SESSION['login_error']);

$identifierValue = htmlspecialchars((string)($_POST['identifier'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
?>

<div class="content sign-in-page">
    <div class="container">
        <div class="sign-in-card">
            <div class="sign-in-header">
                <p class="heading-2">Admin <span>Sign In</span></p>
                <p class="text-muted">Access the FitPal control center</p>
            </div>

            <?php if ($errorMessage !== ''): ?>
            <div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                <?php echo htmlspecialchars($errorMessage, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>
            </div>
            <?php endif; ?>

            <form method="POST" action="../backend/handlers/sign-in-handler.php" class="sign-in-form" id="signInForm"
                novalidate>

                <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token"
                    value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['csrf_token'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>">

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="identifier" class="form-label">Email or Username</label>
                    <input type="text" id="identifier" name="identifier" class="form-control"
                        placeholder="Enter your email or username" autocomplete="username" required
                        value="<?php echo $identifierValue; ?>">
                    <div class="form-error" id="identifierError"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="password" class="form-label">Password</label>
                    <div class="password-wrapper">
                        <input type="password" id="password" name="password" class="form-control"
                            placeholder="Enter your password" autocomplete="current-password" required>
                        <button type="button" class="password-toggle" id="togglePassword"
                            aria-label="Toggle password visibility" tabindex="-1">
                            <img src="<?php echo $assetBase; ?>assets/images/icons/password-hide.svg" alt=""
                                id="passwordIcon">
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-error" id="passwordError"></div>
                </div>

                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-block" id="signInBtn">
                    Sign In
                </button>
            </form>

            <div class="sign-in-footer">
                <p class="text-muted">
                    Not an admin? <a href="<?php echo $assetBase; ?>../customer/pages/sign-in.php">Customer sign-in</a>
                </p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
    'use strict';
    var form = document.getElementById('signInForm');
    var toggle = document.getElementById('togglePassword');
    var password = document.getElementById('password');
    var icon = document.getElementById('passwordIcon');
    if (toggle && password && icon) {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
            var isPwd = password.type === 'password';
            password.type = isPwd ? 'text' : 'password';
            icon.src = isPwd ?
                '../../shared/assets/images/icons/password-unhide.svg' :
                '../../shared/assets/images/icons/password-hide.svg';
        });
    }
    if (form) {
        form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            var ident = document.getElementById('identifier');
            var idErr = document.getElementById('identifierError');
            var pwdErr = document.getElementById('passwordError');
            [ident, password].forEach(function(el) {
                if (el) el.classList.remove('error');
            });
            [idErr, pwdErr].forEach(function(el) {
                if (el) {
                    el.textContent = '';
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
            var ok = true;
            if (!ident.value.trim()) {
                ident.classList.add('error');
                idErr.textContent = 'Please enter your email or username.';
                idErr.style.display = 'block';
                ok = false;
            }
            if (!password.value) {
                password.classList.add('error');
                pwdErr.textContent = 'Please enter your password.';
                pwdErr.style.display = 'block';
                ok = false;
            }
            if (!ok) e.preventDefault();
        });
    }
})();
</script>
```

```css
/**
 * FitPal Customer Cart Page Styles
 * Version 2.8 — Reserves the viewport scrollbar gutter on <html> so
 *                hiding the body scrollbar does not change the
 *                viewport width. Reverted the modal-content width
 *                experiments from v2.5–2.7: they were addressing a
 *                shift that the scrollbar gutter prevents at the root.
 *
 * @package FitPal
 * @version 2.8
 */

/* Reserve the scrollbar gutter permanently. With this in place, the
   viewport's usable width is identical whether a scrollbar is visible
   or not, so nothing reflows when the body scrollbar is hidden by a
   modal scroll lock. */
html {
    scrollbar-gutter: stable;
}

/* ============================================
   CONTENT WRAPPER
   ============================================ */

.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 70px);
    background: var(--gray-50);
}

.cart-page {
    padding: 24px 0 60px 0;
}

.cart-page .container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 16px;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* ============================================
   PAGE TITLE HEADER
   ============================================ */

.page-title-header {
    margin-bottom: 24px;

}

.page-title-header .heading-2 {
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;

    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
}

}

    margin: 0;
}

}

}

.alert-danger {

}

/* ============================================

    justify-content: center;
}

.cart-modal-icon img {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    display: block;
}

.cart-modal-body {
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.cart-modal-title {
    margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
}

.cart-modal-text {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--gray-600);
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.cart-modal-text strong {
    color: var(--text);
}

.cart-modal-footer {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
}

.cart-modal-footer .btn {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease,
                color 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.cart-modal-footer .btn-secondary {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a1a;
}

.cart-modal-footer .btn-secondary:hover,
.cart-modal-footer .btn-secondary:focus {
    background: #000000;
    border-color: #000000;
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.cart-modal-footer .btn-danger {
    background: var(--danger, #dc2626);
    color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid var(--danger, #dc2626);
}

.cart-modal-footer .btn-danger:hover,
.cart-modal-footer .btn-danger:focus {
    background: #b91c1c;
    border-color: #b91c1c;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3);
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE — TABLET (≤ 768px)
   ============================================ */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .cart-page { padding: 16px 0 40px 0; }

    .page-title-header .heading-2 { font-size: var(--font-size-2xl); }

    .cart-section-head { padding: 12px 16px; }

    .cart-item {
        grid-template-columns: 24px 80px 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 16px 0;
    }

    .cart-item-image { width: 80px; height: 80px; }

    .cart-item-controls {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        flex-direction: row;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 10px;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .cart-item-subtotal { margin-left: auto; }

    .cart-summary { padding: 20px; }
    .cart-summary-amount { font-size: var(--font-size-2xl); }

    .cart-summary-actions { flex-direction: column-reverse; }
    .cart-summary-actions .btn { width: 100%; min-width: 0; }
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE — MOBILE (≤ 480px)
   ============================================ */

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .cart-items { padding: 4px 14px 12px 14px; }

    .cart-section-head {
        padding: 12px 14px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .cart-select-all-text { font-size: var(--font-size-xs); }

    .cart-item {
        grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 16px 0;
    }

    .cart-item-select {
        grid-row: 1 / 3;
        align-self: flex-start;
        padding-top: 4px;
    }

    .cart-item-image {
        grid-column: 2 / 3;
        width: 100%;
        height: 160px;
    }

    .cart-item-details {
        grid-column: 2 / 3;
    }

    .cart-item-controls {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
    }

    .cart-item-quantity { align-self: center; }
    .cart-item-subtotal { justify-content: center; margin-left: 0; }
    .cart-item-remove { width: 100%; }

    .cart-summary { padding: 16px; }
    .cart-summary-amount { font-size: var(--font-size-2xl); }

    .empty-state { padding: 40px 20px; min-height: 320px; }
    .empty-state-icon { width: 60px; height: 60px; }
    .empty-state-icon img { max-width: 32px; max-height: 32px; }

    .cart-modal-content { padding: 24px 18px 18px 18px; }
    .cart-modal-footer { flex-direction: column-reverse; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .cart-item,
    .cart-item-quantity,
    .cart-item-quantity .qty-btn,
    .cart-item-remove,
    .cart-summary-actions .btn,
    .cart-customs-toggle,
    .cart-customs-toggle-icon,
    .cart-checkbox-mark,
    .cart-checkbox-mark::after,
    .cart-select-all .cart-checkbox-mark,
    .cart-select-all .cart-checkbox-mark::after,
    .cart-modal,
    .cart-modal-overlay,
    .cart-modal-content,
    .cart-modal-footer .btn {
        transition: none !important;
    }
}
```

```css
/**

/* ============================================
   CONTENT WRAPPER
   ============================================ */

.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 70px);
    background: var(--gray-50);
}

}

    max-width: 1200px;

}

   ============================================ */

.checkout-title {

    color: var(--text);
    border-bottom: 3px solid var(--primary);

}

/* ============================================

.alert {

}

.checkout-grid {

}

.card {

}

.card:hover {

}

.card-header {

}

.card-header .heading-5 {

}

.card-header .badge {

}

.card-body {

}

/* ============================================

.detail-row {

}

.detail-value {

}

/* ============================================

.address-display {

.address-display-label .badge-default {

.address-empty-state {

.address-empty-text {

    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 260px;
}

.address-empty-state .btn {
    min-width: 160px;

}

/* ============================================
   ORDER SUMMARY
   ============================================ */

.order-items {
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    max-height: 220px;
    overflow-y: auto;

}

.order-items::-webkit-scrollbar {

.order-items::-webkit-scrollbar-track {

}

}

.order-item {

}

.order-item:last-child {

}

.order-item-image {
    width: 60px;

    border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);

}

.order-item-image img {

}

.order-item-info {

}

.order-item-name {

.order-item-restaurant {

.order-item-customizations {

.order-item-price {

}

/* ============================================
   ORDER TOTALS
   ============================================ */

.order-totals {
    border-top: 2px solid var(--gray-200);

}

.totals-row {
    display: flex;

.totals-row-note {

.totals-row.total {

.total-amount {

}

/* ============================================
   CUSTOM RADIO BUTTONS
   ============================================ */

.payment-option input[type="radio"],
.address-option input[type="radio"] {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.payment-option input[type="radio"] + label,
.address-option input[type="radio"] + label {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 32px;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
}

.payment-option input[type="radio"] + label::before,
.address-option input[type="radio"] + label::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border: 2px solid var(--gray-300);
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.payment-option input[type="radio"] + label::after,
.address-option input[type="radio"] + label::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 6px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0);
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--white);
    transition: transform 0.12s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.payment-option input[type="radio"]:checked + label::before,
.address-option input[type="radio"]:checked + label::before {
    background: var(--primary);
    border-color: var(--primary);
}

.payment-option input[type="radio"]:checked + label::after,
.address-option input[type="radio"]:checked + label::after {
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1);
}

.payment-option input[type="radio"]:focus-visible + label::before,
.address-option input[type="radio"]:focus-visible + label::before {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.25);
}

.payment-options {

.payment-description {

/* ============================================

   ============================================ */

.checkout-actions {

.btn-secondary:hover,

.btn-primary {

.btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: var(--primary-dark);

.btn-primary:disabled {

.btn-primary.loading {

    border-top-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {

}

/* ============================================

.modal {

.modal-close:hover {

}

.modal-body {

}

.modal-subtitle {

}

.modal-subtitle a {

    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

.modal-subtitle a:hover {

}

.address-list {

}

.address-option {

}

    border-color: var(--gray-300);
}

.address-option.selected {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    background: #f6fcf5;
}

.address-option-content {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.address-option-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.address-option-label {
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.address-option-text {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--gray-600);
    word-break: break-word;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.badge-default {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 1px 8px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--white);
}

/* ============================================
   MODAL FOOTER
   ============================================ */

.modal-footer {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 16px 24px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.modal-footer .btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    min-height: 44px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

/* Shared icon inside modal footer buttons — sizes and tints
   the <img> to match the previous inline SVG. */
.modal-footer .btn .btn-icon {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    display: block;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
}

.modal-footer .btn-secondary {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

.modal-footer .btn-secondary:hover,
.modal-footer .btn-secondary:focus {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    opacity: 0.9;
}

.modal-footer .btn-primary {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--white);
}

.modal-footer .btn-primary:hover {
    background: var(--primary-dark);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

/* ============================================
   QR PAYMENT MODAL
   ============================================ */

.qr-modal-content {
    max-width: 400px;
}

.qr-modal-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    text-align: center;
}

.qr-amount-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
}

.qr-amount-label {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    color: var(--gray-500);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

.qr-amount {
    font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--primary);
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.qr-image-wrapper {
    width: 220px;
    height: 220px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid var(--primary);
    background: var(--white);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    padding: 8px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.qr-image-wrapper img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    display: block;
}

.qr-note {
    padding: 10px 14px;
    background: #fff3cd;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--warning);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    color: #856404;
    line-height: 1.5;
    text-align: left;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.qr-note strong {
    color: #856404;
}

/* ============================================
   WALLET INSUFFICIENT MODAL
   ============================================ */

.wallet-modal-content {
    max-width: 420px;
}

.wallet-modal-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 4px 0;
}

.wallet-modal-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.15);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.wallet-modal-icon img {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    opacity: 0.75;
    display: block;
}

.wallet-modal-title {
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.3;
}

.wallet-modal-text {
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--gray-600);
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin: 0;
}

.wallet-balance-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: var(--gray-50);
    border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    text-align: left;
}

.wallet-balance-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.wallet-balance-row .label {
    color: var(--gray-500);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}

.wallet-balance-row .value {
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
}

.wallet-balance-row.available .value {
    color: var(--primary);
}

.wallet-balance-row.shortfall .value {
    color: var(--danger);
}

/* ============================================
   CONFIRM ORDER MODAL
   ============================================ */

.confirm-modal-content {
    max-width: 420px;
    padding: 32px 24px 24px 24px;
    text-align: center;
}

.confirm-modal-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    background: rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.1);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.confirm-modal-icon img {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    display: block;
    opacity: 0.85;
}

.confirm-modal-title {
    margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.3;
}

.confirm-modal-text {
    margin: 0 0 24px 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--gray-600);
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.confirm-modal-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
}

.confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    font-family: inherit;
    min-height: 46px;
}

.confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn-cancel {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #1a1a1a;
}

.confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn-cancel:hover {
    background: #000000;
    border-color: #000000;
}

.confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn-confirm {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: var(--primary);
}

.confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn-confirm:hover {
    background: var(--primary-dark);
    border-color: var(--primary-dark);
}

.confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn-confirm:disabled {
    opacity: 0.6;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE - TABLET
   ============================================ */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .checkout-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 16px;
    }

    .checkout-grid {
        gap: 16px;
    }

    .checkout-page {
        padding: 16px 0 40px 0;
    }

    .checkout-page .container {
        padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .card-body {
        padding: 16px 16px 18px 16px;
    }

    .card-header {
        padding: 12px 16px;
    }

    .card-header .heading-5 {
        font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    }

    .order-item {
        padding: 10px 0;
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .order-item-image {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }

    .order-item-name {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .order-item-price {
        font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    }

    .order-totals .totals-row {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .order-totals .totals-row.total {
        font-size: var(--font-size-base);
    }

    .total-amount {
        font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
    }

    .payment-option {
        padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .payment-icon {
        margin-right: 10px;
    }

    .payment-icon img,
    .payment-icon svg {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
    }

    .payment-label {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .payment-description {
        font-size: 0.65rem;
    }

    .payment-option input[type="radio"] + label,
    .address-option input[type="radio"] + label {
        padding-left: 28px;
    }

    .payment-option input[type="radio"] + label::before,
    .address-option input[type="radio"] + label::before {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
    }

    .payment-option input[type="radio"] + label::after,
    .address-option input[type="radio"] + label::after {
        left: 5px;
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
    }

    .address-display {
        padding: 12px 14px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .address-display-icon img {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
    }

    .address-display-text {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .address-display-label {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .address-display .btn-outline {
        padding: 4px 12px;
        font-size: 0.65rem;
    }

    .address-empty-state {
        padding: 24px 16px;
        min-height: 190px;
    }

    .address-empty-icon {
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .address-empty-icon img {
        max-width: 24px;
        max-height: 24px;
    }

    .address-empty-title {
        font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    }

    .address-empty-text {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .checkout-actions {
        padding: 14px 16px 16px 16px;
        flex-direction: row;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .checkout-actions .btn {
        padding: 12px 16px;
        font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
        min-height: 44px;
        flex: 1;
    }

    .checkout-title {
        font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .modal-content {
        max-width: 95%;
        margin: 10px;
    }

    .modal-body {
        padding: 16px;
    }

    .modal-header {
        padding: 14px 16px;
    }

    .modal-footer {
        padding: 12px 16px;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .modal-footer .btn {
        min-height: 40px;
        padding: 10px 16px;
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .address-option {
        padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .address-option-label {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .address-option-text {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .modal-subtitle {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .detail-label {
        width: 60px;
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .detail-value {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .detail-row {
        padding: 6px 0;
    }

    .qr-image-wrapper {
        width: 180px;
        height: 180px;
    }

    .qr-amount {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
    }

    .wallet-modal-icon {
        width: 56px;
        height: 56px;
    }

    .wallet-modal-icon img {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
    }

    .wallet-modal-title {
        font-size: var(--font-size-base);
    }
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE - MOBILE
   ============================================ */

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .checkout-page .container {
        padding: 0 10px;
    }

    .card-body {
        padding: 12px 12px 16px 12px;
    }

    .card-header {
        padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .payment-option {
        padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .payment-icon {
        margin-right: 8px;
    }

    .payment-icon img,
    .payment-icon svg {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
    }

    .payment-option input[type="radio"] + label,
    .address-option input[type="radio"] + label {
        padding-left: 26px;
    }

    .payment-option input[type="radio"] + label::before,
    .address-option input[type="radio"] + label::before {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        border-width: 1.5px;
    }

    .payment-option input[type="radio"] + label::after,
    .address-option input[type="radio"] + label::after {
        left: 4px;
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
    }

    .checkout-actions {
        padding: 12px 12px 14px 12px;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .checkout-actions .btn {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 12px 16px;
        font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
        min-height: 44px;
    }

    .order-item {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .order-item-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100px;
    }

    .order-item-info {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .order-totals .totals-row {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
        padding: 4px 0;
    }

    .order-totals .totals-row.total {
        font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    }

    .total-amount {
        font-size: var(--font-size-base);
    }

    .checkout-title {
        font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
    }

    .address-display {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .address-display .btn-outline {
        align-self: flex-start;
    }

    .address-option {
        padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .modal-body {
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .modal-footer {
        padding: 10px 12px;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .modal-footer .btn {
        width: 100%;
        flex: none;
        min-height: 38px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
    }

    .qr-image-wrapper {
        width: 160px;
        height: 160px;
    }

    .wallet-balance-card {
        padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .wallet-modal-text {
        font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    }

    .confirm-modal-content {
        padding: 24px 18px 18px 18px;
    }

    .confirm-modal-icon {
        width: 56px;
        height: 56px;
    }

    .confirm-modal-icon img {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
    }

    .confirm-modal-actions {
        flex-direction: column-reverse;
    }

    .confirm-modal-actions .modal-btn {
        width: 100%;
    }
}
```

## File: `fitpal/customer/assets/css/dashboard.css`

```css
/**
 * FitPal Customer Dashboard Styles
 * Version 3.1 — Header button and stat-card arrows use shared icons.
 *
 * Layout map:
 *   .dashboard-page
 *     .container
 *       .dashboard-header
 *       .stats-grid           (4 cards)
 *       .dashboard-row        (analytics + profile, both stretch)
 *       .orders-card          (3 rows, no blank space)
 */

/* ============================================
   CONTENT WRAPPER
   ============================================ */

.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 70px);
}

.dashboard-page {
    background: var(--gray-50);
    padding: 24px 0 32px 0;
    flex: 1;
}

.dashboard-page .container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 16px;
    width: 100%;
}

/* ============================================
   HEADER
   ============================================ */

.dashboard-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 16px;
}

.dashboard-greeting .heading-2 {
    margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.dashboard-greeting .heading-2 span {
    color: var(--primary);
}

.dashboard-greeting .text-muted {
    color: var(--gray-500);
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

/* Shared icon inside the "Browse Menu" button — sized and
   tinted white so it renders on the primary green background. */
.dashboard-actions .btn-icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    display: block;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
}

/* ============================================
   STAT CARDS
   ============================================ */

.stats-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.stat-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    padding: 18px 20px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    position: relative;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.stat-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    border-color: var(--gray-200);
}

.stat-card:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

.stat-icon {
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.stat-icon img { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

.stat-icon-orders  { background: rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.12); }
.stat-icon-balance { background: rgba(23, 162, 184, 0.12); }
.stat-icon-week    { background: rgba(108, 216, 92, 0.14); }
.stat-icon-goal    { background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.14); }

.stat-icon-orders img {
    filter: invert(48%) sepia(70%) saturate(450%) hue-rotate(75deg) brightness(95%) contrast(85%);
}
.stat-icon-balance img {
    filter: invert(52%) sepia(70%) saturate(600%) hue-rotate(160deg) brightness(92%) contrast(85%);
}
.stat-icon-week img {
    filter: invert(48%) sepia(70%) saturate(450%) hue-rotate(75deg) brightness(95%) contrast(85%);
}
.stat-icon-goal img {
    filter: invert(79%) sepia(90%) saturate(600%) hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(95%) contrast(85%);
}

.stat-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.stat-number {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.2;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.stat-number-text {
    font-size: var(--font-size-base);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

.stat-label {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    color: var(--gray-500);
    margin: 2px 0 0 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}

.stat-hint {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    color: var(--gray-500);
    margin: 2px 0 0 0;
}

.stat-hint-active {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

/* Stat card trailing arrow — shared icon, tinted via filter. */
.stat-arrow {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}

.stat-arrow-img {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    display: block;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    /* Neutral gray tint for the resting state */
    filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(75%) sepia(0%) saturate(0%) brightness(95%) contrast(90%);
    transition: filter 0.15s ease;
}

.stat-card:hover .stat-arrow {
    transform: translateX(2px);
}

.stat-card:hover .stat-arrow-img {
    /* Tint to primary green on hover */
    filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%)
            invert(48%) sepia(70%) saturate(450%)
            hue-rotate(75deg) brightness(95%) contrast(85%);
}

/* ============================================
   TWO-COLUMN ROW
   Both columns stretch to the tallest sibling.
   ============================================ */

.dashboard-row {
    display: grid;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: stretch;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.dashboard-row-primary {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.dashboard-card {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

.dashboard-card .card-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dashboard-card .card-header .heading-5 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-base);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

.card-link {
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--primary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}

.card-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* ============================================
   ANALYTICS
   ============================================ */

.analytics-card .analytics-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    gap: 20px;
}

/* ── Chart ── */

.weekly-chart {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
    height: 240px;
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 200px;
}

/* Y-axis labels */
.chart-y-axis {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
    padding: 0 4px 22px 0; /* bottom space for the x-axis labels row */
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--gray-400);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    line-height: 1;
}

.chart-y-label {
    white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Plot area (gridlines + bars) */
.chart-plot {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

/* Horizontal gridlines — absolutely positioned, one per y-axis value */
.chart-gridline {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--gray-100);
    height: 0;
}

/* Distribute gridlines evenly over the plot area, minus the label row */
.chart-plot .chart-gridline {
    bottom: 22px; /* label row height */
}

.chart-plot .chart-gridline:nth-child(1) { top: 0; bottom: auto; }
.chart-plot .chart-gridline:nth-child(2) { top: 25%; }
.chart-plot .chart-gridline:nth-child(3) { top: 50%; }
.chart-plot .chart-gridline:nth-child(4) { top: 75%; }
.chart-plot .chart-gridline:nth-child(5) { top: auto; bottom: 22px; }

/* Column area */
.chart-columns {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
    padding-bottom: 22px; /* space for x-axis labels */
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    min-height: 0;
}

.chart-column {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 6px;
}

/* Track is a positioning box: bar fills it from the bottom */
.chart-bar-track {
    flex: 1;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
}

.chart-bar {
    width: 60%;
    max-width: 42px;
    min-height: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--secondary) 0%, var(--primary) 100%);
    border-radius: 6px 6px 3px 3px;
    transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
}

.chart-bar.is-empty {
    background: var(--gray-200);
    min-height: 4px;
}

.chart-bar.is-today {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.25);
}

.chart-bar:hover,
.chart-bar:focus-visible {
    filter: brightness(1.06);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.22);
}

.chart-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    color: var(--gray-500);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.chart-label.is-today {
    color: var(--primary);
}

/* Tooltip */
.chart-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: var(--text);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    transition: opacity 0.12s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
    z-index: 10;
}

.chart-tooltip.is-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ── Analytics summary strip ── */

.analytics-summary {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.analytics-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    min-width: 0;
}

.analytics-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--gray-500);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.analytics-value {
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.analytics-hint {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--gray-400);
}

/* ============================================
   PROFILE SNAPSHOT
   ============================================ */

.profile-snapshot-card .profile-snapshot {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
}

.snapshot-avatar-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.snapshot-avatar {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--white);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.snapshot-name-block { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }

.snapshot-name {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.snapshot-email {
    margin: 2px 0 0 0;
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    color: var(--gray-500);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.snapshot-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.snapshot-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--gray-500);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.snapshot-value {
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--text);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}

.snapshot-tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
}

.tag {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.tag-diet {
    background: rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.12);
    color: var(--primary-dark);
}

.tag-allergen {
    background: #fee2e2;
    color: #991b1b;
}

.snapshot-btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ============================================
   RECENT ORDERS (own row)
   ============================================ */

.orders-card {
    /* inherits .dashboard-card */
}

.compact-orders {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.compact-order-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 14px 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.compact-order-row:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.compact-order-row:hover {
    background: var(--gray-50);
}

.compact-order-row:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
    outline-offset: -2px;
}

.compact-order-id-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
    gap: 2px;
}

.compact-order-id {
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.compact-order-date {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    color: var(--gray-500);
}

.compact-order-total {
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-align: right;
    min-width: 90px;
}

/* ============================================
   BADGES
   ============================================ */

.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.badge-warning    { background: #fff3cd; color: #856404; }
.badge-info       { background: #d1ecf1; color: #0c5460; }
.badge-primary    { background: #cce5ff; color: #004085; }
.badge-success    { background: #d4edda; color: #155724; }
.badge-danger     { background: #f8d7da; color: #721c24; }
.badge-secondary  { background: var(--gray-200); color: var(--gray-600); }

/* ============================================
   EMPTY STATE
   ============================================ */

.empty-state {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 36px 20px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}

.empty-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    margin: 0 auto 14px;
    background: var(--gray-100);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.empty-icon img {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    opacity: 0.4;
}

.empty-title {
    font-size: var(--font-size-base);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
    color: var(--text);
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;
}

.empty-description {
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    color: var(--gray-500);
    margin: 0 0 16px 0;
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================ */

@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .dashboard-row-primary { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

    .profile-snapshot-card .profile-snapshot {
        flex: initial;
    }

    .profile-snapshot-card .snapshot-btn {
        margin-top: 12px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .dashboard-page { padding: 16px 0 24px 0; }

    .dashboard-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }

    .dashboard-greeting .heading-2 { font-size: var(--font-size-2xl); }

    .dashboard-actions .btn {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .weekly-chart { height: 200px; }
    .chart-y-axis { font-size: 10px; }
    .chart-label  { font-size: 10px; }
    .chart-columns { gap: 6px; }

    .analytics-summary {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .analytics-item {
        padding: 8px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--gray-100);
    }
    .analytics-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .compact-order-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
        grid-template-areas:
            "id    status"
            "id    total";
        row-gap: 4px;
        padding: 12px 6px;
    }
    .compact-order-id-block { grid-area: id; }
    .compact-order-row .badge { grid-area: status; justify-self: end; }
    .compact-order-total { grid-area: total; text-align: right; min-width: 0; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }

    .stat-card {
        padding: 14px;
        gap: 10px;
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .stat-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
    .stat-icon img { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .stat-number { font-size: var(--font-size-base); }
    .stat-arrow { display: none; }

    .dashboard-card { padding: 16px; }

    .weekly-chart { height: 170px; }
    .chart-y-axis { display: none; }
    .weekly-chart { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .chart-label { font-size: 9px; }
    .chart-value { font-size: 9px; }
}
```

```css
/**
 * FitPal Customer Header Styles
 * 
 * Customer-specific header overrides and additions.
 * Uses global CSS variables from global.css.
 */

/* ============================================
   CUSTOMER HEADER OVERRIDES
   ============================================ */

.customer-header {
    /* Ensure consistent height with shared header */
    height: 70px;
    min-height: 70px;
    max-height: 70px;
}

.customer-header .header-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    height: 100%;
}

/* ============================================
   NAVIGATION LINKS
   ============================================ */

.customer-header .nav-link {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--gray-600);
    padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-3);
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    position: relative;
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.customer-header .nav-link:hover {
    color: var(--primary);
    background-color: var(--gray-50);
}

.customer-header .nav-link.active {
    color: var(--primary);
    background-color: rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.1);
}

.customer-header .nav-link.active::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -2px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 20px;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: var(--primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

/* ============================================
   BUTTONS - Match Shared Header Exactly
   ============================================ */

.customer-header .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--spacing-2);
    padding: var(--spacing-2) var(--spacing-4);
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
    font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.customer-header .btn-sm {
    padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    min-height: 32px;
}

.customer-header .btn-primary {
    background-color: var(--primary);
    color: var(--white);
    border-color: var(--primary);
}

.customer-header .btn-primary:hover,
.customer-header .btn-primary:focus {
    background-color: var(--primary-dark);
    border-color: var(--primary-dark);
    color: var(--white);
}

.customer-header .btn-outline {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--text);

}

.customer-header .btn-outline:hover,
.customer-header .btn-outline:focus {

}

/* ============================================
   NAV ACTIONS
   ============================================ */

.customer-header .nav-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--spacing-3);
}

.customer-header .logout-btn {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
    padding: var(--spacing-1) var(--spacing-3);
    min-height: 32px;
}

/* ============================================
   MOBILE MENU - MATCH SHARED HEADER (OPTIMISED)
   ============================================ */

/* Menu toggle button */
.menu-toggle {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    padding: var(--spacing-2);
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1001;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.menu-toggle:hover {
    background: var(--gray-50);
}

.menu-icon {
    display: flex;

}

.menu-icon .bar {
    display: block;

    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease;
    transform-origin: center;
}

.menu-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(1) {
    transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
}

.menu-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(2) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scaleX(0);
}

.menu-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(3) {
    transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
}

/* Mobile overlay - positioned below header so toggle stays clickable */
.mobile-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 70px;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100vh - 70px);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);

}

.mobile-overlay.active {

.mobile-nav {

    transform: translateX(100%) translateZ(0);
    transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    contain: layout;
}

/* Shadow pseudo-element to avoid repainting moving layer */
.mobile-nav::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: -30px;
    width: 30px;
    height: 100%;
    box-shadow: -30px 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

    transform: translateX(0);
}

.mobile-nav.open {

}

.mobile-nav::-webkit-scrollbar {

}

.mobile-nav-link:hover {

}

/* ============================================

.mobile-user-greeting {

}

/* ============================================

/* ============================================

        font-size: 17px;

/* NEW FEATURE */

/* ============================================

   ============================================ */

.mobile-nav-link .nav-badge {
    margin-left: 6px;
}
```

```css
/**
 * FitPal Menu Page - Filter Bar Styles
 * Version 8.2
 *
 * Fixes:
 *  - Dropdown panels anchor precisely to their trigger button
 *  - Dietary dropdown grows to fit its content (no scrollbar on desktop)
 *  - Checkmarks and radio dots render as solid white on their fill colour
 *  - Filter bar is position: fixed under the header (no scroll drift)
 *  - Fixed bar's inner content aligns with the header container width
 */

/* ============================================
   FIXED FILTER BAR
   Full-width fixed bar. Inner .filter-form is
   constrained to match the header container so
   the search/controls line up with the header.
   ============================================ */

.menu-filters {
    position: fixed;
    top: 70px;              /* match header height */
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    background: var(--background);
    padding: 10px 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
}

/* Spacer so page content starts below the fixed bar */
.filter-spacer {
    height: 74px;           /* filter bar height + gap; tune if needed */
}

/* ============================================
   INNER CONTAINER
   Mirrors the page header's max-width and
   horizontal padding so the bar lines up.
   ============================================ */

.filter-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;      /* match header container max-width */
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 20px;        /* match header container side padding */
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* ============================================
   LAYOUT: STACKED
   Search on top, controls below, always.
   ============================================ */

.filter-top-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
    width: 100%;
}

/* ============================================

   ============================================ */

.auto-filter-notice {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    background: rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--gray-700);
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.auto-filter-icon {
    flex: 0 0 auto;

    align-items: center;
}

.auto-filter-icon img {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    opacity: 0.6;
}

.auto-filter-text {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.auto-filter-text strong {

}

.auto-filter-reset {

}

}

/* ============================================

.filter-search-group {

.search-wrapper {

    font-size: 14px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
    background: var(--white);
}

.search-wrapper input:focus {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(89, 193, 74, 0.15);

}

.search-btn {

}

/* ============================================

   ============================================ */

.filter-controls-group {

/* ============================================
   DROPDOWN WRAPPER

.filter-dropdown {

}

/* ============================================

.filter-dropdown-toggle {

}

.filter-dropdown-toggle .filter-dropdown-label {

    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    font-size: 13px;

}

.filter-dropdown-toggle .filter-dropdown-badge {
    display: inline-flex;

    border-radius: 11px;
```
